evidence: log loss +0.0107 (95% interval +0.0001 to +0.0198). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

211 picks, ROI +1.9% (95% interval -9.0% to +12.3%), win rate 60.2% against a break-even 58.6%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 16% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.09 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,937 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,778; a 1% edge takes 44,430. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
